gen-fs-oswald-gf-faustina: Tightly knit rows give Oswald a confident, compressed punch right away. Faustina brings bowls that thin gently and an open-jawed c, so the body feels authoritative without turning sharp.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-halant: Compact, confident, built like a block of type. Halant takes over with a faint stroke contrast and a towering x-height, giving Oswald's tight rows a softer, larger-lettered partner underneath.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-quando: Neon glows with uniform line width on every letter and open spacing between glyphs. But Quando, bookish and widely spaced, does the steadier text work while Neon does the glowing.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-laila: Editorial and traditional, the body text leaves generous room between curve ends and stems. Laila meets New Title's tightly linked, high-lowercase letters with a moderate height of its own, and that gap is the pair's best trait.
